steps.say: This voice is a model with four and a half million parameters.
And it was trained without a single recording of a person.

scenes.headline: Three small speech models, three kinds of small
scenes.sub: tiny-voca, Kitten TTS 2 Mini and Tontaube
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Ravel. Three text to speech models came out this week, all called small. They mean different things by it.

params.pulse: pulse train at the predicted pitch

steps.say: Start with tiny voca. Its waveform begins as a pulse train, one click per vocal fold cycle, at the pitch the network predicts.
Beside it, plain noise, for breath and hiss.

steps.term: Cepstrum: a compact code for a spectral envelope
steps.say: Every ten point seven milliseconds the network predicts a filter for each source, as a cepstrum.
Filter both, add them, and you have speech. The whole synthesizer is twenty-five thousand eight hundred and sixty-two parameters.

scenes.title: A training set with no recordings

steps.say: The two voices began as sentences describing them, rendered by a bigger model, Qwen three T T S.
That teacher read every sentence in both voices.
Whisper checked each clip, and failures were made again or dropped.
An aligner timed every phoneme.
Then tiny voca trained from scratch, in under eight hours on one GPU. No person in the data. But the teacher, Whisper and the aligner all learned from people.

steps.caption: total $9.56 on one rented RTX 4090
steps.say: The whole project cost under ten dollars of GPU time. Making the data cost more than training.

scenes.title: Kitten TTS 2 Mini is Kokoro's graph

steps.say: Kitten T T S two Mini has Kokoro's exact configuration. Phonemes go through a small BERT, then a prosody predictor.

steps.term: Voice pack: a table of styles, one row per length
steps.say: A voice is just a file, a table of style vectors with one row per input length.
The decoder makes the waveform. It is two thirds of the model, stored as int eight, eighty-two point seven megabytes.

scenes.title: Tontaube on a CPU: weights read per frame

steps.term: Codebook: one row of codec codes
steps.say: Tontaube is two point nine billion parameters in four transformers, one per codebook. The first decides the words and the timing.
Three smaller ones add acoustic detail.
The second refinement is smaller again. In four bits, each frame still reads every one of them.
And the third is the smallest.
About one point two gigabytes of weights per eighty milliseconds.
Real time needs about fifteen gigabytes a second from memory, before any arithmetic. That is the floor, not the whole bill.

scenes.title: Times real time, one six-core CPU
scenes.say: Then I ran all three on one old six-core CPU. tiny voca made speech over a hundred times faster than real time, Kitten about three times, and Tontaube under half. On a GPU, Tontaube reached about five times.

scenes.text: Small can mean few parameters, few bytes, or few bits. Check which one before you ship it.
scenes.say: Small can mean parameters, bytes or bits. Check which one before you ship it.
